top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards one testable chemical idea, induced proximity between a target and an E3 ligase, through the PROTAC concept (Crews, Deshaies) and the cereblon mechanism of thalidomide-type glues (Handa). It has two decades of independent reproduction and approved glue degraders in patients. The costs are real: Sakamoto and Ciulli are omitted and no bifunctional degrader is approved. P002 (Buchwald, Hartwig) is the mature, cleanly attributed fallback. P003 ranks third because the code-expansion credit is as entangled as B037 and base editing is still young. P004 is a sound but more distant methods prize, and a prize is preferable to no award.
